document_title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
issuing_authority: National Biodiversity Authority (NBA), Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
official_reference: Act No. 18 of 2003 / Act No. 10 of 2023
snippet: Certain persons not to undertake biodiversity-related activities without approval of National Biodiversity Authority. Applies to non-citizens, non-residents, and foreign-incorporated or foreign-controlled entities (including Indian companies having any foreign shareholding or management control). Requires Form I application to NBA before obtaining any biological resource occurring in India.
keywords: section 3, foreign entities, nba approval, form 1, foreign shareholding, biological resource access

document_title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
official_reference: Act No. 18 of 2003 / Act No. 10 of 2023, Section 6
snippet: Application for intellectual property rights not to be made without approval of National Biodiversity Authority. Any person applying for any IPR in or outside India for any invention based on research or information on biological resources obtained from India must obtain prior approval of NBA via Form III. In case of patent applications, approval may be obtained after filing but before the grant of the patent.
keywords: section 6, form iii, ipr approval, patent filing nba, prior approval, biological invention

document_title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and Biological Diversity (Amendment) Act, 2023
issuing_authority: National Biodiversity Authority & State Biodiversity Boards (SBBs)
snippet: Prior intimation to State Biodiversity Board for commercial utilization of biological resources. Under the 2023 Amendment Act, registered AYUSH practitioners (Vaidyas and Hakims), codified traditional knowledge holders, and entities accessing cultivated medicinal plants (with Certificate of Origin) are explicitly exempted from prior intimation and payment of Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) fees to SBBs.
keywords: section 7, state biodiversity board, 2023 amendment, vaidyas exemption, cultivated medicinal plants, abs fee exemption

document_title: Guidelines on Access to Biological Resources and Associated Knowledge and Benefits Sharing Regulations, 2014
snippet: Specifies fair and equitable benefit sharing mechanisms. Commercial utilization options: 0.1% to 0.5% of ex-factory gross sales or 3.0% to 5.0% of purchase price of biological resources. For IPR commercialization, benefit sharing ranges between 0.2% to 1.0% of annual gross sales or 2.0% to 5.0% of licensing royalty received.
keywords: benefit sharing rates, ex-factory sales, nba regulations 2014, royalty sharing, fair and equitable
